items.title: Unit 10 · A new friend!
items.scene: Dear Beth, This is a photo of me with my four friends. We are on a roundabout at the park. All my friends are great. Emily is my best friend. She's got brown hair. It's long and curly. Charlie is Emily's little brother. He's five. He's quite short and he's got black, short hair. Isabel is a good friend, too. She's tall and she's got long, blond hair. Her eyes are blue. Danny is my cousin. He's in the photo, too. He's tall and he's got brown hair and brown eyes. Can you see him? He's got a blue T-shirt. I'm in the photo, too. I have very long, straight hair and brown eyes. Can you see me? Have you got a photo of you and your friends? Please write soon. From, Katie.
